_meta.note: Controls whether development fixtures may be loaded for layout preview. Published queries never use fixtures, regardless of this flag.

steps: Set includeDevelopmentFixtures to false in this file.
Remove or empty files under /js/data/fixtures/ once real catalogue content is imported.
Keep /js/data/home-fixtures.json only until homepage sections are driven by production sections data; then replace or delete it.
Confirm published pages, related-content, navigation, and search return empty or production records – never fixture fallbacks.
